# 3 bed terraced house for sale

> **ON VIEW THIS SATURDAY, 3RD OCTOBER, FROM 12.00PM UNTIL 12.40PM** Frank Fleming Estate Agent is delighted to present to the market No.16 Cliftonville Road. A spacious and extended 3-bedroom period property located right in the heart of Glasnevin. Built by Alexander Strain in the early part of the last century.
